_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against the bugfest reference baseline of 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

deployment.description: Stateless Spring Boot module; all state (calendars, openings, exceptions) is stored in PostgreSQL, so multiple instances can run side by side. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password, usually from the secret store

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed by the container launcher; keep consistent with the heap and metaspace sizing in the java section

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container (MiB)

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation for the sidecar container (MiB)

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-okapi-facade backend container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-okapi-facade module deployed alongside this sidecar
